newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-PROFESSIONALS GIVE SHOES TO HELP SOUTH AFRICAN PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-PROFESSIONALS GIVE SHOES TO HELP SOUTH AFRICAN PLAYERS.

text.p: South African David Frost has collected 600 pairs of golf shoes from fellow professionals to give to golfers in South Africa.
Frost told a news conference he had written to all the professionals on the U.S. Tour asking for donations.
"I got donations from everyone," Frost said. "Arnold Palmer sent me a signed pair -- I don't know why he signed them -- Roberto de Vincenzo sent me a pair and Jack Nicklaus sent me five pairs."
Frost said the shoes would go to caddies, underprivileged players and beneficiaries of the South African PGA's development scheme.
